latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of gh-taskqueue: an in-memory priority task queue for AI agent workflows.
- Supports creating tasks with priorities and tags.
- Allows claiming the highest-priority pending task.
- Tasks can be marked as complete or failed.
- Filter tasks by status or tag and retrieve queue statistics.
- Lightweight API endpoints provided for easy integration.
